name: Infernus applies its Burn DoT after a Lava Shard hit (#4605)
contract: #4605: 92124 Infernus is a real Pyromancer talent (CharacterAdvancement 4037) whose native effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL(706874), but AscensionPyromancer::ApplyContracts (AscensionPyromancerContracts.cpp) neuters that effect to SPELL_AURA_DUMMY and zeroes ProcFlags/ProcCharges for every id in PyromancerDrivers (AscensionPyromancerData.h), which lists 92124 -- so the native proc path is intentionally dead, and rev_20260909_11_pyromancer_completion.sql's DELETE-without-reINSERT of the spell_proc row for 92124 matches that design rather than a missing row. The real trigger is hardcoded: pyromancer_spells::OnSpellHitResult (AscensionPyromancerAbilities.cpp) casts 706874 at the struck target whenever Named(info, 803950) -- Lava Shard's granted rank-chain root (ClassSpells {24,4,803950}; spell_ranks roots the chain at 803950), not 803948, an unrelated Spell.dbc record with the same display name that nothing in this fork grants or references -- lands damage and player->HasAura(92124) is true. This scenario proves that hardcoded path already delivers the DoT; no code or SQL change is made.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Without Infernus, Lava Shard alone does not apply the Burn DoT
Infernus passive is applied to the caster once learned
Infernus applies its Burn DoT after the Lava Shard hit
